import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int add(int a, int b) { a += b; return a >= mod ? a - mod : a; }
    static void ckadd(int[] a, int b) { a[0] = add(a[0], b); } // we'll use arrays to mimic reference? Actually we'll use static methods that return and assign manually.
    // But in the code we have ckadd on int references; in Java we need to mimic by using array or just assign: a = add(a,b). In the original code, ckadd is used with reference. We'll implement ckadd as static method that modifies via array, but it's easier to just use a = add(a,b) directly in the translated code. However to keep exact structure, we'll define a helper that takes an int[] of length 1. Or we can change calls to a=add(a,b). Since the translation should have same functionality, we can adapt. Let's use a wrapper class or just inline.
    // I'll define a static class RefInt? Simpler: replace each ckadd(x,y) with x = add(x,y). Similar for cksub, ckmul.
    // The original code used ckadd(blok[x], ...) etc. We'll replace with blok[x] = add(blok[x], ...) etc.
    // But note: there is a place: ckadd(ans, ...) so we can do ans = add(ans, ...)
    // Similarly for dp[i][j] and ways[i][j].
    // So we will not use ckadd function but inline the addition.
    static int sub(int a, int b) { a -= b; return a < 0 ? a + mod : a; }
    static void cksub(int a, int b) { a = sub(a, b); } // not used in main
    static int mul(int a, int b) { return (int)((long)a * b % mod); }
    static void ckmul(int a, int b) { a = mul(a, b); } // used with blok[x] = mul(blok[x], x+1);
    static int powmod(int x, int k) { int ans = 1; for (; k > 0; k >>= 1, x = mul(x, x)) if ((k & 1) == 1) ans = mul(ans, x); return ans; }
    static int inv(int x) { return powmod(x, mod - 2); }
    
    static final int N = 505;
    static int[] blok = new int[N];
    static int[] sum = new int[N];
    static int c2(int x) { return (int)((long)x * (x + 1) / 2 % mod); }
    static int[][] dp = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] ways = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] binom = new int[N][N];
    
    static void calc() {
        binom[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
            binom[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                binom[i][j] = add(binom[i-1][j], binom[i-1][j-1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();
        calc();
        blok[0] = 1;
        for (int x = 1; x <= m; x++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= x; i++) {
                int t1 = mul(blok[i-1], mul(blok[x-i], binom[x-1][i-1]));
                blok[x] = add(blok[x], t1);
                int t2 = mul(add(c2(i-1), c2(x-i)), mul(blok[i-1], mul(blok[x-i], binom[x-1][i-1])));
                sum[x] = add(sum[x], t2);
                int t3 = mul(sum[i-1], mul(mul(blok[x-i], binom[x-1][i-1]), x+1));
                sum[x] = add(sum[x], t3);
                int t4 = mul(sum[x-i], mul(mul(blok[i-1], binom[x-1][i-1]), x+1));
                sum[x] = add(sum[x], t4);
            }
            blok[x] = mul(blok[x], x+1);
        }
        ways[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                for (int sz = 1; sz <= i; sz++) {
                    int t5 = mul(ways[i-sz][j-1], mul(blok[sz], binom[m-i+sz][sz]));
                    ways[i][j] = add(ways[i][j], t5);
                    int t6 = mul(ways[i-sz][j-1], mul(sum[sz], binom[m-i+sz][sz]));
                    dp[i][j] = add(dp[i][j], t6);
                    int t7 = mul(dp[i-sz][j-1], mul(blok[sz], binom[m-i+sz][sz]));
                    dp[i][j] = add(dp[i][j], t7);
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int zero = n - m;
            int lef = zero - (i - 1);
            if (lef >= 0) {
                ans = add(ans, mul(dp[m][i], binom[i+1+lef-1][lef]));
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
